title: Hades
shortDescription: A rapid action game that makes repeated escape attempts feel meaningful through flexible builds, sharp combat, and evolving character conversations.
highlights: Weapon aspects and boons support distinct combat approaches
Story progression gives failed attempts a rewarding sense of continuity

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A central PC action-RPG selection for combining immediate combat feedback with unusually generous run-to-run storytelling.
